definitions.gloss: appearance; visual appeal; how something looks
definitions.explanation: The visual impression something makes; how attractive or impressive something appears when viewed.

examples.japanese: {見栄|みば}えのする{料理|りょうり}を{作|つく}る。
examples.english: To make a visually appealing dish.

examples.japanese: {見栄|みば}えが{良|よ}いほうが{売|う}れやすい。
examples.english: Things that look better sell more easily.

examples.japanese: {見栄|みば}えより{味|あじ}を{重視|じゅうし}したい。
examples.english: I want to prioritize taste over appearance.

notes:
{見栄|みば}え focuses on visual impression.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {見栄|みば}えがする: to look impressive/attractive
- {見栄|みば}えが{良|よ}い: to have good visual appeal
- {見栄|みば}えを{良|よ}くする: to improve the appearance

USAGE:
- Often used for food, presentations, displays
- Emphasizes the visual aspect specifically

RELATED WORDS:
- {見|み}た{目|め}: appearance, looks (more general)
- {体裁|ていさい}: form, appearance, decorum
- {外見|がいけん}: outward appearance

cross_references.label: how something looks on screen or in photos
